positionEvidence.scope: Observed maximum native positions per distinct queued local WAV; not emitted duration. Exact captured waveform comparison is required.

limits: Bounded running-app routes only. Runner must independently gate emitted signal and cleanup; exact waveform matching/continuity and human listening remain separate. No M3, startup-clock or total-memory-envelope acceptance. Native scene support is recorded, never presumed for quantized variants.

nativeMainResponsiveness.scope: Monotonic UI-isolate roundtrip through the native main-thread channel; unchanged 250ms gate. Wall-clock request/native-entry/return stamps and active-app state diagnose delivery only and never replace the gate. No utility query or keyboard/mouse delivery claim.

peakRuntimeBytesByEngine.scope: Existing runtime sampler; not a total application memory envelope
